name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "*"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - run: npm ci

      - run: npm run build

      - name: Package release assets
        run: |
          mkdir obsidian-map
          cp main.js manifest.json styles.css gi-icons.json obsidian-map/
          zip -r obsidian-map.zip obsidian-map

      - name: Create or update release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          tag="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
          assets="main.js manifest.json styles.css gi-icons.json obsidian-map.zip"
          if gh release view "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$tag" $assets --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$tag" --title "$tag" --generate-notes $assets
          fi
